versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the API Ingestion Connectors skill.
- Enables ingestion of data from REST, GraphQL, and OAuth-protected APIs into graph-ready structures.
- Supports multiple authentication methods including API key, bearer token, and OAuth2.
- Handles diverse pagination strategies (offset/limit, page-based, cursor-based).
- Transforms API responses into node-edge and RDF triple formats for ETL and knowledge graph construction.
- Provides error handling with retry logic, schema validation, and rate limit compliance.
